1.text: By the fig and the olive<sup foot_note="228254">1</sup>

footnotes.228254: - Referring to the places known for their production, i.e., Damascus and Jerusalem, respectively. It could also refer to the fig and olive trees or to the fruits themselves.

4.text: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;<sup foot_note="228255">1</sup>

footnotes.228255: - i.e., upright, symmetrical, and balanced in form and nature.

5.text: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,<sup foot_note="228256">1</sup>

footnotes.228256: - This can refer to the depths of Hell, to decrepit old age or to immorality.

6.text: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.

7.text: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?<sup foot_note="228257">1</sup>

footnotes.228257: - More literally, "What makes you lie concerning it?"

8.text: Is not Allāh the most just of judges?
